newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila share index soars 2.16 pct at close.
newsitem.headline: Manila share index soars 2.16 pct at close.

text.p: * Wall Street's post-election record rise buoys sentiment
Blue chips and selected secondliners were snapped amid heavy volume on Thursday, lifting the index higher at close, traders said.
"We have very aggressive buying. People were just eager to participate on account of the Dow Jones rise," said Felix Barrientos, trader at ING Barings Securities.
The main index rose for the seventh straight session, up by 64.63 points, or 2.16 percent, to 3,063.06.
Traders said aside from the Dow Jones' almost 100 points rise on Wednesday, PLDT's $5/8 rise to $59 3/4 in Wall Street cheered investors.
Bargain hunters chose to buy blue chips Petron Corp, Ayala Corp, PLDT and secondliner Filinvest Land Inc.
Gainers outnumbered losers 79 to 40 with 64 issues unchanged. Value turnover was 3.6 billion pesos.

Juanis Barredo, analyst at Citisecurities Inc said the market could fall back on Friday. "The market is due for a correction and it may happen once we tread the 3,100 level," Barredo said. - KATHERINE ESPINA 63 2 841-8937 Fax 8176267
